# Overview

Reproduces the MSI-status row of Table 1 in Oh et al. (2026).
RAV-RF and RAV-LR on the 12 selected MSI RAVs are compared against the
MMR-gene expression panel on a combined COAD/STAD/UCEC cohort.

Canonical artefacts (single source of truth for manuscript numbers):

- `results/aim1_msi_status_metrics.rds`
- `results/aim1_msi_status_cv.rds`

# Data dependency

`MSI_Status/data/combined_data.rds`, a `SummarizedExperiment` of the
three TCGA cohorts. See `MSI_Status/setup.R` for the construction
script.

# Pipeline

```{r}
library(InferPheno)
library(SummarizedExperiment)
library(MultiAssayExperiment)

rav_model <- load_rav_model()

combined <- readRDS(proj_path("MSI_Status/data/combined_data.rds"))
msi_col  <- paste0(
  "patient.microsatellite_instability_test_results.",
  "microsatellite_instability_test_result.",
  "mononucleotide_and_dinucleotide_marker_panel_analysis_status")
combined <- combined[, combined[[msi_col]] %in% c("msi-h", "mss")]

expr  <- assay(combined)
rav   <- project_to_rav(expr, rav_model)

pheno <- data.frame(
  sample_id = colnames(combined),
  cohort    = combined$admin.disease_code,
  phenotype = ifelse(combined[[msi_col]] == "msi-h", "msi", "mss"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
dat <- join_rav_pheno(rav, pheno)

selected_ravs <- paste0("RAV", c(517, 220, 2109, 1303, 324, 438, 868,
                                 834, 190, 1166, 2344, 357))

cv_rf <- cv_oof(dat, selected_ravs, k = 5L, fitter = fit_rf,  seed = 1L)
cv_lr <- cv_oof(dat, selected_ravs, k = 5L, fitter = fit_logit, seed = 1L)

panel <- run_msi_expression_panel(expr)
panel_prob <- panel$prob[match(dat$sample_id, rownames(panel$prob)), "msi"]

list(
  rf    = auc_ci(cv_rf$truth, cv_rf$msi),
  lr    = auc_ci(cv_lr$truth, cv_lr$msi),
  panel = auc_ci(dat$phenotype, panel_prob),
  delong_rf_vs_panel = paired_delong(dat$phenotype, cv_rf$msi, panel_prob)
)
```
